title: A review on microplastics: sources, environmental fate, degradation pathways, and analytical identification methods
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13851-13874
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09062H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kavitha Kamalasekaran, Ashok K. Sundramoorthy
The review examines microplastic contamination, sources, distribution, toxicity, and biodegradation, details analytical methods, and highlights advances in electrochemical sensor design for detecting microplastics in complex environments.
